method: Targeted web searches, primary-source follow-up, revision checking and deduplication against the October database and existing November intake. Not an exhaustive systematic search; no PRISMA flow or estimated coverage claimed.
representative_queries_executed: site.microsoft.com "Energy use of AI inference" Oviedo 2026
"What Work Does Generative AI Do" Bick Blandin August 2026
"To Boldly Go Where No One Has Gone Before" Choudhuri arxiv 2026
query_log_scope: Representative exact queries from the session, not a complete search-engine transcript. Other candidates were followed from topical searches and primary-source links. No search-result counts reconstructed.
verification_policy: Each selected record names its actual reading scope, verified identity, method and limitations. Content-checked can mean a checked public abstract, not full-text reading or independent replication. Pending arXiv DOIs and placeholder proceedings metadata are not promoted to verified identifiers.

important_version_observation.rejected_stale_substitution: Earlier approximately 6,000-executive, four-country abstract and its estimates
important_version_observation.basis: Local Chrome revision/date/abstract opening plus complete current publisher-indexed abstract and expanded author list. Full revised paper not inspected.

known_not_duplicated.reason: Programming productivity/learning meta-analysis already in the database.
Broad ILO literature review already present; the newly selected digital-divide paper is a different study.
Broad OECD productivity synthesis already present.
Contractor/Reyes learning experiment, arXiv 2607.08849, already present.
Scientific impact/diversity study already present; new creativity experiment adds an incentive intervention rather than duplicating it.

deferred_or_excluded.title: Does Generative AI Narrow Education-Based Productivity Gaps? Evidence from a Randomized Experiment
deferred_or_excluded.reason: Local Chrome confirmed February issue and October revision, but the public abstract truncates before results. An August arXiv version exists; its outcomes were not substituted for the current revision. No download agreeing to terms or consuming a free-download allowance was performed.

deferred_or_excluded.title: Firm-level AI productivity evidence, NBER Working Paper 34984
deferred_or_excluded.reason: Additional executive survey identified, but potential survey-program overlap with Firm Data on AI needs checking. Avoid treating related reports and expectations as independent causal studies.

deferred_or_excluded.title: Agentic AI systems for scientific discovery
deferred_or_excluded.reason: Relevant new methods primer identified; full authorship and content appraisal not completed. Companion PrimeView would not be a separate empirical study.

deferred_or_excluded.title: Training AI Scientists to Replicate Research
deferred_or_excluded.reason: Potentially useful replication benchmark; developer evaluation, rubric validity and scientific-fidelity outcomes need deeper inspection before admission.

deferred_or_excluded.title: Organizational Incentives and Returns to Technology Adoption
deferred_or_excluded.reason: Organizational technology analogy does not by itself constitute an AI intervention.

limits: No inference that the selected references exhaust recent literature or establish field-wide effect sizes.
Qualitative studies, surveys, quasi-experiments, randomized interventions, benchmarks and commentary remain distinct.
No downloaded publisher PDFs or complete article text redistributed.
October manuscript, evidence database, release manifest, site, PDF and archives remain unchanged.
Appropriately dated November verification and editorial promotion are still required.
